author: tkrupa-intel
title: Android CMake configure fails: MODULE_LIBRARY plugins cannot be linked via ov_generate_plugins_hpp
signature: target of type MODULE LIBRARY may not be linked into another target in ov generate plugins hpp|Code Issue

failed_jobs.name: Build arm64
failed_jobs.symptom: CMake Error: MODULE_LIBRARY targets (openvino_auto_plugin, etc.) cannot be linked via ov_target_link_plugins

failed_jobs.name: Build x64
failed_jobs.symptom: Same CMake MODULE_LIBRARY link error in plugins.cmake:275

key_errors:
CMake Error at cmake/developer_package/plugins/plugins.cmake:275 (target_link_libraries):
  Target "openvino_intel_gpu_plugin" of type MODULE_LIBRARY may not be linked into
  another target.
  Call Stack:
    cmake/developer_package/plugins/plugins.cmake:325 (ov_target_link_plugins)
    cmake/extra_modules.cmake:186 (ov_generate_plugins_hpp)
    CMakeLists.txt:196 (include)
root_cause: The Android CMake build fails because plugins (openvino_auto_plugin, openvino_intel_gpu_plugin, openvino_intel_cpu_plugin, openvino_hetero_plugin, openvino_auto_batch_plugin) are built as MODULE_LIBRARY targets but ov_generate_plugins_hpp/ov_target_link_plugins in cmake/developer_package/plugins/plugins.cmake:275 attempts to link them into another target, which CMake forbids. This is a pre-existing infrastructure bug in the Android build configuration unrelated to PR #37311 (GPU kernel .cl file changes). The failure has occurred 18 times since 2026-08-08.
reproduction_steps: N/A - requires Android cross-compile environment; triggers on any merge-queue run of the Android workflow
recommended_actions: Fix cmake/developer_package/plugins/plugins.cmake:275 to not attempt linking MODULE_LIBRARY targets directly
Or change the Android build to use SHARED instead of MODULE for plugin targets when cross-compiling
Create a tracking issue for this blocking Android build regression and assign to the CMake/build-system team
prevention_strategies: Add a CMake pre-configure check that validates plugin library type before attempting to link. Add an Android build test to the pre-merge CI gate so MODULE_LIBRARY regressions are caught before they enter the merge queue.
historical_context: This exact failure has been recorded 18 times since 2026-08-08T01:04:42Z, affecting PRs 37211, 37311, 37192, 37001, 37056, 37123, 37064, 37304. It appears to be a systemic build infrastructure issue blocking many unrelated PRs from merging.
